author: Murphh
body:
I'm making a walls map and I have a question about the borders between the quad and the sand wall separating the quads from middle.

So...this is the corner closest to middle in one quad. 
Which part is protected before drop?
Is it the blocks where the bedrock meets sand?
     or
the blocks in the orange section (one away from bedrock)?

Can this be changed in YML if needed?
I'm still learning, so any feedback would be helpful.  Thanks! :)
